acceptanceCriteria: Each host qualification is retained as evidence with exact versions, or remains NOT_RUN explicitly.
A live multi-repository program integrates each designated repository exactly once, retained as evidence.
Each open question is decided and recorded in the spec, or left open explicitly.
Nothing unrun is reported as passed.
body: The owner accepted #354 on 2026-10-05 with live host qualification NOT_RUN; V1-0475 and V1-0772 complete on that basis. Delivered: CAL-V0-071..072 and 087..088 multi-repository programs (sibling worktrees, composite candidate, review and gates bound to it, designated per-repository integration landing exactly once, per-repository Core context), CAL-V0-089 policy-bounded checkpointed continuation for Codex and OpenCode (Claude Code and token-capped policies refused UNSUPPORTED), CAL-V0-086 PathText worktree bound, unproved-stop SURVIVORS and EPERM re-probe. All with fake-host and focused tests. The orchestrator, under the owner delegation, kept every fail-closed implementation choice (see docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md, Decided 2026-10-05 paragraph in S21). Tracked here: (1) live Codex CLI 0.153.2, Claude Code 2.1.267 and OpenCode 2.0.21 qualification, including a live multi-repository integration, following the exact steps in docs/build-log/2026-10-05-tasks-multirepo-continuation.md; (2) Linux; (3) make gate and units outside internal/tasks and specindex (affected plan: 181 selected, 25 unknowns); (4) revisit, with evidence, the open questions: integrationBranch validated only as a label, an earlier repository staying landed when a later one is TARGET_ADVANCED, continuation ceiling 16, continuation under token caps, a Claude Code continuation, continuable failing closed on transient reads, and the one-way downgrade from multi-repository records and 4096-byte worktreePath; (5) continuation mutations M1 and M4 that survive (documented in the build log). Writer checkpoint part C stays with V1-0645.
title: Multi-repository supervision and checkpointed continuation: live host qualification and owner questions (issue #354 follow-up)
